cases.title: mpg/cyl 计算列（point）
cases.code: ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy / cyl)) + geom_point()

cases.title: stat = count 的柱（离散 x）
boxplot 预计算（stat = identity + 显式五数）
cases.code: ggplot(boxes, aes(x = g)) + geom_boxplot(stat = "identity", position = "identity", aes(lower = lo, upper = hi, middle = mid, ymin = y0, ymax = y1))

cases.title: 双离散 aes（x = drv, fill = class）的 interaction + stack
cases.code: ggplot(mpg, aes(x = drv, fill = class)) + geom_bar()

cases.title: 层级 data 覆盖 plot data（mpg[cyl == 4, ]）
cases.code: ggplot(mpg, aes(x = displ, y = hwy)) + geom_point(data = mpg[mpg$cyl == 4, ])
